findings.observed: A seafoam pleated textile hangs from thirteen separate rings beneath a straight pale rail, with two visible ceiling brackets. Front/rear/level views show the textile and its top attachments; the side view confirms a narrow depth. No markings or patients are depicted.
findings.concerns: Current directional lighting makes angular dark bands in the folds. This needs a softer-light source check before full composition. The ceiling brackets must meet a visible source wall/ceiling support; do not leave the track floating.
findings.animation: No clips or skins. The separate textile has only top/bottom height levels. Any slight hem sway would be newly authored and must preserve the source transform, top contacts and fixed hardware; curved flutter is unsupported without new topology.
findings.recommendation: Candidate for further static composition/light exploration only; no motion or final-art approval.

findings.observed: The original model has a warm wood front, pale high counter, lower side counter, rear cabinets and two monitor assemblies. The low front view mostly reads as a reception counter; the work-side view exposes the desk and monitors. The lowered surface is distinct from the tall front.
findings.concerns: The front counter occludes the monitors from low angles. Use an elevated work-side composition and verify that it remains distinct from a generic empty counter at the target display size. Source dimensions and the accessible name do not establish clinical compliance.
findings.animation: No clips or skins. All displays, counters and cabinets remain static; do not animate medical readings or add monitor sounds.
findings.recommendation: Candidate for further static composition exploration, retaining original geometry/materials and exact source provenance.
